title: Unit 23 Review: Starting, Repeating and Moving On
goal: Review echarse a, ponerse a, romper a, volver a and pasar a, and read a short text about Francisco Coloane and his book Cabo de Hornos.
grammar: inceptive, iterative and sequential periphrases, and a text about Coloane

items: I can tell the sudden starts (*echarse a*, *ponerse a*, *romper a*) apart and choose the right one.
I can use *volver a* for "again" and *no volver a* for "not again".
I can use *pasar a* to move on to the next step.
I can read a short text about Francisco Coloane and his book Cabo de Hornos.
